description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Carrion Feeder didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Carrion Feeder is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
